## User benefit

What would someone learn or be able to do? How does it fit the [roadmap](https://github.com/ArgeliusLabs/Chasing-Your-Tail-NG/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md)?

## Proposed behavior

Describe inputs, outputs and the smallest useful implementation. For a sensor, include hardware, protocol/decoder, identifier behavior and whether reception is passive.

## Evidence and limitations

How would we test it? Include ordinary explanations or failure cases, required hardware and links to primary documentation. Distinguish existing measurements from expected capabilities.
